warmup: Before we start, walk me through your day yesterday, from the morning on. Whatever you actually did.

topics.goal: Whether they have actually built and owned something, or only been near it. Come away knowing one thing that broke, what they chose to do about it, and what it cost them.
How they behave when they are wrong or someone disagrees. Come away knowing one time they changed their mind, who changed it, and what they had believed before.
